name: nGZSceneGraph::cCompositionTreeNodeImpl::CloneInto
notes: Lane OR. Hooked (CloneCompositionInto, a __fastcall free function: thiscall on the source's composition Impl, ret 0x14: source, clone, clone Impl, mode, context). The object-graph Impl's CopyTo (ours), the flags word +0x18 copied, the clone's flag 13 cleared and 12 set; with mode 1 one cNodeCloneContext for the subtree (the caller's, or a new one mapping source to clone, counted once around the loop), each child (first child +0x14, then slot 37) cloned with (1, 0x4512dd13, &out, context), the clone's AddChild (slot 45) given out (null too), out released. Our src/sg callers (cCompositionTreeNode::Clone, cResourceNode::CopyContentTo, cTransformNodeImpl::CloneInto) call ours. SG_CloneContext (160 seeds): a source fake with a random tree of up to 20 child fakes, outsiders, made clones; each child's slot 15 records the context it gets (the caller's fake, or each side's own context by order) and runs 0-5 operations on it (FindClone on tree / outsider / clone / made nodes with three iids, QueryInterface with its iid, 1 and another, AddRef / Release pairs), then hands back the context's clone of itself or a fresh one; every slot call in order, both Impl blocks' words and every fake's count compared. Mutants (19, all killed): the hasher as std::hash, no release in the destructor, the context QI counted, QI of other iids false, the root walk not stopping, deep clone in FindClone, the made clone not released, the walk matching the node itself, the root clone not counted, *out not nulled, flag 13 set, flag 12 not set, the flags not copied, mode tested against 2, AddChild skipped for null, the shared context not counted, the copy not released, the children given the caller context, and a null entry asked again.

name: cNodeCloneContext::FindClone
notes: Lane OR, class and test: 0xa384f0's entry. +8 slot 3 of the game's anonymous cNodeCloneContext (vtable 0xe68d84): a node met for the first time is mapped to its shallow clone (slot 15 with mode 2, iid 0x4512dd13, no context) when it or an ancestor (slot 33) is the root source, else to null; the clone viewed as iid through its QueryInterface, or null. The map is std::unordered_map with the game's identity hash (the key is passed as the hash value), so buckets, rehash and the destructor's release order are the game's. Only CloneInto 0xa384f0 (hooked) builds the context, so the game's vtables are on no live object.

name: cNodeCloneContext::QueryInterface
notes: Lane OR, class and test: 0xa384f0's entry. Primary slot 0 (vtable 0xe68d68): 0xecce4c52 (cINodeCloneContext) gives the +8 face uncounted; anything else is cRZUnknown's (0x1b945c: 1 counted, else false). Called on the +8 face through the thunk 0xa38d08 (its entry).

name: cNodeCloneContext::QueryInterface
notes: Lane OR, class and test: 0xa384f0's entry. The +8 face's adjustor thunk to 0xa38ce0 (sub ecx, 8; jmp); ours is the compiler's, reached by the test through the +8 face (the context the children's Clone is given).

name: cNodeCloneContext::scalar_deleting_destructor
notes: Lane OR, class and test: 0xa384f0's entry. Primary slot 3: each mapped clone released in the map's list order (the identity hash's buckets decide it; null entries skipped), the map freed, then cRZUnknown's destructor and delete 0x30. Reached by the last Release of a context CloneInto made (the test notes every release in order, and the sizes of the blocks freed during each side's call).
